title: Composable delegable shortflows with per-tenant audit trail
creator: Nora Patel
description: Build a composable runtime for lightweight adminlets (shortflows) that can be delegated to first-line support with enforced per-tenant audit trails and minimal latency. Goal is to let on-call and L1 staff execute safe, idempotent remediation shortflows without requiring full operator privileges, while preserving provenance and telemetry for post-incident review.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime component can register shortflow definitions and version them (semantic version string).
A shortflow can be executed via REST API with a tenant-scoped token and returns structured execution events streamed to the Console.
Each execution generates an immutable audit record containing inputs, resolved secrets metadata (KMS id, not plaintext), step-by-step telemetry, and final outcome linkable to a dashboard trace.
Policy enforcement: RBAC layer enforces a delegable permission set (execute, dry-run, escalate) configurable per-tenant and per-shortflow.
Safe mode: runtime supports a dry-run mode that simulates effects and surfaces diffs to the operator before final execution.
